QUOTE: when `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is not defined, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`. ... `library/common.h:132` | `#define MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` | ... sees the real member names.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: States the default rename to `private_##member` and that defining the opt-out exposes the real member names.
